assertion.statement: The D210 maximal Shimura curve quotient X/W is the rational contact line with precisely five index-two branch points, labelled210,105,70,42,30 at infinity,0,1,2401,−343/32 respectively.
assertion.objects: The genus-five maximal-level curve X, its rational Atkin-Lehner group W=(Z/2)^4, and the four published genus-one quotient models.
assertion.hypotheses: The published GR2006 quotient equations, genus and Atkin-Lehner group law are supplied; use characteristic-zero cyclic stabilizers and Riemann-Hurwitz. The exact rational quartic-invariant and cross-ratio computation is retained separately.
assertion.quantifiers: All branch orbits of the full W quotient, not merely the four initially supplied involutions.
assertion.parameter_range: The fixed quaternion discriminant210 and the four involutions30,42,70,105.
assertion.uniformity: The labelled quotient identification is fixed before choosing the rational contact parameter.
assertion.constants: Genus5, group order16, fixed-point total40, five branch orbits each of size8 and inertia2; coordinates2401 and−343/32.
assertion.normalizations: Choose labels210,105,70 at infinity,0,1. Quartic invariants I=12ae−3bd+c², J=72ace+9bcd−27ad²−27b²e−2c³, j=6912I³/(4I³−J²).
assertion.exceptional_cases: This characteristic-zero branch identification does not itself prove the integral tame model or the level-three fine cover. The exact coordinate computation remains a separate finite input.
assertion.limit_order: Use the four genus-one quotients to count fixed points; deduce quotient genus and fifth inertia label; identify rational branch sections; apply exact quartic/cross-ratio calculations to fix the remaining coordinates.
